label: Starship Integrated Flight Tests
delta: IFT-12 (Booster 19 / Ship 39 / Block 3 V3) delayed to late May 2026 (target May 27–31+) after OLP-2 water deluge gas generator explosion on May 5–6 — third delay for IFT-12 (prior: FAA investigation, April RUD). Block 3 stack safe on OLP-2 pad; deluge repair est. 2–3 weeks. Block 3 features Raptor 3 V3 engines, 124.4 m height, 100+ t LEO capacity. Suborbital arc; both stages target ocean splashdown. Bloomberg reports $15B total Starship development spend.
